title: Use color-coding in your Seedance 2.0 prompts to distinguish factions/armies…
content: Use color-coding in your Seedance 2.0 prompts to distinguish factions/armies (e.g., gold for Persians, red for Spartans).
tips: Use color-coding in your Seedance 2.0 prompts to distinguish factions/armies (e.g., gold for Persians, red for Spartans).

es.content: Utiliza la codificación de colores en tus prompts de Seedance 2.0 para distinguir facciones/ejércitos (por ejemplo, dorado para los persas, rojo para los espartanos).

fr.content: Utilisez le codage couleur dans vos prompts Seedance 2.0 pour distinguer les factions/armées (par exemple, or pour les Perses, rouge pour les Spartiates).

ja.content:

ko.content: Seedance 2.0 프롬프트에서 색상 코딩을 사용하여 진영/군대를 구분하세요 (예: 페르시아인에게는 금색, 스파르타인에게는 빨간색).
